analysis.reasoning: The call reflects a company in transition, pivoting from hyper-growth to 'efficiency.' While management shows high confidence in their structural changes (layoffs, flattening org) and technological progress (AI/Reels), the financial reality of Q4 showed significant pressure: ad pricing dropped 22% and revenue growth was flat/negative due to macro headwinds. CapEx enthusiasm is low as they are explicitly lowering guidance to optimize spend. However, management consistency is high as they are executing the 'efficiency' roadmap promised in previous quarters.
